founder.name: Randy Kendel
bio: Boundry was founded by Randy Kendel, an independent technology builder focused on application infrastructure, distributed systems, developer platforms, and agentic software.
Randy’s approach centers on a simple principle: build systems that make software more capable, reliable, and useful through better architecture and infrastructure.
His work spans databases, application platforms, agent execution, authorization, and the infrastructure connecting them.
He is developing Boundry as a unified technology ecosystem where individual products solve distinct problems while contributing to a larger architectural vision.
